title.original: Utility-Guided Agent Orchestration for Efficient LLM Tool Use
title.zh: 面向高效 LLM 工具使用的效用引导式智能体编排
title.en: Utility-Guided Agent Orchestration for Efficient LLM Tool Use

inclusion_reason.zh: 该效用策略为回答、检索、工具、验证和停止提供显式、可调的运行时决策层，可跨工具 Agent 复用。
inclusion_reason.en: The utility policy provides an explicit, tunable runtime decision layer over answer, retrieve, tool, verify, and stop actions that can be reused across tool agents.

abstract.zh: 该工作把工具 Agent 编排显式建模为效用决策，而非完全交给提示中的自由推理。策略在回答、检索、工具调用、验证和停止之间选择，综合估计收益、步骤成本、不确定性与冗余，提供可控的质量—成本权衡。
abstract.en: This work models tool-agent orchestration as an explicit utility decision rather than leaving control entirely to free-form prompting. A policy chooses among answer, retrieve, tool, verify, and stop actions by combining expected gain, step cost, uncertainty, and redundancy.

problem.zh: 固定流程稳定但缺乏适应性，ReAct 等自由多步方法又可能过度调用工具、延长轨迹并增加 token 与时延，运行时缺少明确的停止和验证控制。
problem.en: Fixed workflows are stable but inflexible, whereas free-form methods such as ReAct can overuse tools, lengthen trajectories, and increase tokens and latency without explicit stopping or verification control.

approach.zh: 策略为候选动作计算轻量效用，按潜在质量增益扣除成本、不确定性和重复惩罚，并通过阈值与冗余控制决定继续、验证或停止。
approach.en: The policy scores candidate actions with a lightweight utility that balances potential quality gain against cost, uncertainty, and repetition penalties, using thresholds to continue, verify, or stop.

system_design.zh: 编排器在每步收集当前答案、工具历史、置信与成本信号，效用模块对动作打分，策略层执行最高价值动作并将新状态反馈到下一轮。
system_design.en: At each step, the orchestrator collects the current answer, tool history, confidence, and cost signals; a utility module scores actions, executes the best option, and feeds the resulting state into the next decision.

key_results.zh: 与直接回答、固定流程、阈值控制和 ReAct 的比较表明，显式效用信号会系统改变调用与停止行为，并可用轻量规则获得可解释的质量—成本折中。
key_results.en: Comparisons with direct answering, fixed workflows, threshold control, and ReAct show that explicit utility signals materially change tool and stopping behavior and can produce interpretable quality–cost trade-offs.

limitations.zh: 效用取决于人工选择的成本、增益与不确定性代理，校准偏差可能过早停止或过度验证；论文不宣称该策略在所有任务上达到最佳质量。
limitations.en: Utility depends on hand-chosen proxies for cost, gain, and uncertainty; miscalibration can stop too early or over-verify, and the paper explicitly does not claim universally best task quality.

notes.zh: 工具 Agent 场景和五类策略比较来自官方摘要；摘要没有给出模型、任务集、硬件或统一数值，成本定义与策略分项待全文审计。
notes.en: The tool-agent setting and five policy classes come from the official abstract; it gives no model, task set, hardware, or aggregate number, and cost definitions and per-policy results await full-text audit.
